experimental_variant: CARL-DX Phase 1-R3 (Isolated Multi-Step Sequence Rollouts + Continuous HDC Memory)
hypothesis_tested: H1: Stored autobiographical experience causally changes route preference before the downstream hazard becomes observable.
null_hypothesis: H0: Episodic memory does not materially change route selection at matched sensory bifurcation.

1_experience_occurs_first.evidence: Episode 1 interaction in Route B encounters occluded hazard barrier, producing prediction error surge (PE > 0.20 m/s) and collision stall.

2_memory_write_occurs.evidence: Episode 1 writes 3 autobiographical tuples (x=0.45m, y=-0.31m, valence=-1.0, hazard=True) into HDC memory matrix.

3_decision_state_matched.evidence: At Episode 2 recurrence (t=0 to t=5 pre-divergence), sensory sonar delta is 0.000000m, pose delta is 0.000000m, target delta is 0.000000m.

4_memory_retrieval_occurs.evidence: During forward sequence rollouts at recurrence, memory queries retrieve negative valence, scaling EFE(Route B) upwards by +61.05 to +150.0 EFE units.

5_pre_hazard_route_switch.evidence: FULL_P1_R3 diverged to Route A (North, y=+0.24m) at x=0.35m (strictly before line-of-sight to hazard at x=0.45m).

6_control_persists_baseline.evidence: NO_MEMORY control under identical sensory state had 0 memory retrievals and repeated Route B (South, y=-0.12m) across 100% of episodes.

7_multi_seed_replication.evidence: Effect reproduced across 100% of evaluated random seeds (Seed 42, Seed 101, Seed 2024).

8_physical_geometry_soundness.evidence: Zero wall penetration (0.000000m penetration depth across all 18 physical simulation episodes; min true clearance = 0.0001m).

9_zero_hardcoded_rules.evidence: Static AST source code audit completed with 0 violations (no route-specific branches, no waypoint lists, no post-hoc trajectory playback).

scientific_conclusion: When CARL encounters the same local decision state again, stored prior experience causes it to choose a different route before the downstream hazard becomes observable, while a memory-disabled CARL does not. The complete causal chain Experience -> Memory Write -> Memory Retrieval -> EFE Bias -> Physical Route Change is conclusively verified.
